Ape Escape FMV Skipping
=======================

This built-in feature moves Ape Escape's existing Skip FMVs switch from the
generic Display settings into Mods.

When enabled, the runtime mutes and accelerates streaming XA/MDEC playback.
The game still reaches its normal end-of-movie path, preserving completion
side effects. The feature defaults on to preserve Ape Escape's previous
configuration.
